title: Definition of Carnot Cycle
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly define what a Carnot cycle is.

title: pV and ST Diagrams
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide accurate illustrations of the Carnot cycle on both pV and ST diagrams.

title: Efficiency Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the efficiency formula for the Carnot engine correctly.

title: Use of Ideal Gas Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply the ideal gas law appropriately in the derivation.

title: Final Efficiency Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must present the final expression for efficiency as eta = 1 - T2/T1.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the efficiency calculation.

title: Reversibility Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the impact of reversibility on the efficiency of the Carnot cycle.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
